corrections.text: The Analysis section quotes APIContext CEO Mayur Upadhyaya as saying, "When there's an outage, it impacts a greater number of users." This phrasing is not a verbatim quotation. The cited SDxCentral article states that Upadhyaya "noted the incident itself wasn't the story, but the 'concerning trend' of provider consolidation, meaning that when there's an outage, it impacts a greater number of users" — only "concerning trend" is presented in the source as his exact words; the rest is the reporter's paraphrase, not a direct quote.
